name: caps-n-case
title: Caps N Case
description: Quickly convert text case to uppercase, lowercase, sentence case, and title case directly from Raycast.
author: dalileo

commands.name: uppercase-text
commands.title: Convert to UPPERCASE
commands.subtitle: Caps N Case
commands.description: Converts the selected or clipboard text to uppercase letters

commands.name: lowercase-text
commands.title: Convert to Lowercase
commands.subtitle: Caps N Case
commands.description: Converts the selected or clipboard text to lowercase letters

commands.name: sentence-case-text
commands.title: Convert to Sentence Case
commands.subtitle: Caps N Case
commands.description: Capitalizes the first letter while keeping the rest lowercase

commands.name: title-case-text
commands.title: Convert to Title Case
commands.subtitle: Caps N Case
commands.description: Capitalizes major words following English grammar rules

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
